name: ParticleTextForm
description: Particles converge from a wide swirl into the actual pixel-shape of a text string (e.g. 'MAGE'). No image overlay — the particles ARE the text.

tokens.name: text
tokens.description: Text to assemble into. Short uppercase words work best (4–6 chars).

tokens.name: assemblyDuration
tokens.description: Total assembly arc in seconds (1.0–scene length).

tokens.name: fontFamily
tokens.description: CSS font-family stack used for the text shape.

tokens.name: fontWeight
tokens.description: Font weight for the text shape.

tokens.name: tagline
tokens.description: Optional small uppercase tagline that fades in below.
